name: Hornero Sun Card
description: Sun Card 2.0: dashboard astronomy card and contextual bar indicator with sunrise/sunset from PluginKit Weather plus derived day length, sun progress and next sun event. Approximations are labelled derived.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Weather & Astronomy 2.0: astronomy detail derived from the facade sunrise/sunset strings (day length, sun progress, next sun event), contextual bar indicator, configurable density, typed settings, host-context layout and Spanish catalog. Solar noon, twilight and moon times are not exposed by the facade and are labelled unavailable.
Dashboard card showing sunrise, sunset, temperature, description and humidity from PluginKit Weather, with a not-configured state when no location is set.

showTemperature.description: Show temperature and description from the Weather facade (the 1.x behaviour).

showHumidity.description: Show relative humidity when the Weather facade reports it (the 1.x behaviour).

showAstronomy.description: Show astronomy detail derived from sunrise/sunset: day length, sun progress and the next sun event.

dataDensity.description: compact shows only sunrise/sunset; standard keeps the 1.x rows plus astronomy; detailed adds the unavailable-fields note.
